manifest.purpose: Phase 4 D1 baseline: RF-DETR-Nano trained 40 epochs on merged D1 (train 1804, val 591), best-total checkpoint (EMA weights), export for ONNX parity and gated frozen-test eval

dataset.name: merged
dataset.license_summary: see LICENSE file next to the dataset

checkpoint.selected_by: best validation mAP 50:95 across epochs (checkpoint_best_total = EMA weights, val mAP50:95 0.6915)

dets.description: normalized cxcywh boxes in the 640x640 letterboxed frame

labels.description: logits with num_classes + 1 channels; channel 0 = hold; independent sigmoid

dataset.note: see tools/train/DATASET_CARD.md for sources, licenses, and split provenance

method.preprocess: letterbox 640x640 pad 114 centered, RGB float32 NCHW, raw 0..255 (no normalization)
method.nms: class-agnostic greedy NMS at IoU 0.65 over anchors scoring at least 0.01, applied in the harness (the graph has none)
method.map_definition: single-class AP at IoU 0.5, VOC 2010+ all-point interpolation over confidence-ranked detections
method.matching: greedy highest-IoU, confidence descending, one GT claimed once

phase_4_gates.note: docs/requirements.md section 6. The operating threshold must be chosen on the val split, not test.
